What documents are required for a Current Account?

The appropriate proprietor, private limited company, limited liability partnership (LLP) or partnership firm rubber stamp; personal and business Aadhaar and PAN information; three photos; business letterhead; Form G; MOA and AOA; and the certificate of registration.
Can I close a Daily Deposit before maturity?

Within 4 months: a 4% penalty plus Rs 20 service charge and 18% GST. Between 4 and 6 months: only the principal/deposit amount is returned, without interest. Between 6 and 12 months: 2% p.a. interest, as stated by the institution. On maturity: interest is earned.
Can my spouse be the guarantor for my loan?
The borrower and guarantor should not belong to the same family. However, a spouse may be a co-borrower.
The institution states that it does not make accounts dormant. It prefers continuous follow-up to keep accounts active.
Can I transfer my shares to someone else?
Shares cannot be transferred to another person. They may be withdrawn after 5 years from the date of ownership.
Who owns Sakhi Multistate Co-operative Credit Society?
The members are the owners of Sakhi Multistate Co-operative Credit Society.
What is the society’s government-audit status?
The current website states that Sakhi Multistate Co-operative Credit Society has Grade A government-audit status.
Are there hidden charges or third-party commissions?
There are no hidden charges and no third-party commissions on deposits or loans. All fees are disclosed.
Do senior citizens and ladies receive additional benefits?
Senior citizens and ladies receive 0.25% extra on deposits.

How does Sakhi support women’s empowerment?
